analysis.executiveSummary: Corgi Loaf Baking Co. proposes trading RB David Montgomery and a 2027 2nd-round pick (Badland Banditos) to Northside Kings for WR Mike Evans. While Mike Evans (82.7 C-AVI) provides an explosive weekly ceiling upgrade at FLEX over Montgomery (77.9 C-AVI), the submitted offer represents a steep overpay to a rebuilding front office. Giving up both a starting-caliber running back and a premium 2nd-round pick for a 33-year-old wide receiver needlessly guts Corgi Loaf's RB depth reserve in a 16-team league. AVI recommends revising the offer to a 1-for-1 swap of Montgomery for Evans, or substituting draft capital plus a bench wideout to protect critical running back depth.

submitted.summary: Corgi Loaf Baking Co. overpays for 33-year-old Mike Evans by attaching a 2027 2nd-round pick to RB David Montgomery, yielding only a marginal FLEX upgrade (+4.8 C-AVI) while depleting essential 16-team running back depth.

recommended.summary: Removing the 2027 2nd-round pick creates a balanced 1-for-1 veteran swap (David Montgomery for Mike Evans) that delivers immediate WR ceiling for Corgi Loaf's title push without overpaying in draft capital.

championshipOutlook.summary: Adds Mike Evans' high-upside scoring punch to the WR/FLEX starting rotation for the current season.

overall.summary: Slight net loss due to overpaying draft capital and weakening RB depth for a modest FLEX boost.

visualImpact.explanation: The submitted transaction favors Northside Kings significantly in asset value. While Corgi Loaf gains a minor starting WR/FLEX upgrade in Mike Evans, paying David Montgomery plus a 2027 2nd-round pick is an unnecessary overpay that creates dangerous running back depth fragility in a 16-team format.

officialAviAnalysis.sideAChampionshipImpact: Corgi Loaf improves starting FLEX2 baseline by +4.8 C-AVI by inserting Mike Evans (82.7 C-AVI) over David Montgomery (77.9 C-AVI), but reduces active RB starter reserves.
officialAviAnalysis.sideADynastyImpact: Negative long-term value impact (-22.3 net D-AVI) by surrendering a 2027 2nd (48.5 AVI) and a 29-year-old RB (77.0 D-AVI) for a 33-year-old WR (73.2 D-AVI).
officialAviAnalysis.sideARosterImpact: Concentrates elite WR power (Evans, JSN, DeVonta Smith, Malik Nabers), but leaves the RB group reliant strictly on Cam Skattebo and Chuba Hubbard with minimal backup coverage.
officialAviAnalysis.sideBChampionshipImpact: Northside Kings lowers current weekly ceiling slightly by moving Evans, but gains RB2 baseline stability with Montgomery.
officialAviAnalysis.sideBDynastyImpact: Positive dynasty move for a rebuilder (+22.3 net value), turning a 33-year-old veteran receiver into a 2027 2nd pick and a tradeable/usable 29-year-old RB.
officialAviAnalysis.sideBRosterImpact: Improves RB depth significantly with Montgomery joining Harvey and Lloyd, while opening WR opportunities for Addison, Shakir, and Worthy.
officialAviAnalysis.valueAssessment: The package heavily favors Northside Kings on raw asset value (126.4 AVI given vs 82.7 AVI received). Corgi Loaf pays a high tax for a modest FLEX upgrade.

publicMarketAnalysis.summary: Public market sentiment views Mike Evans as a premier win-now WR who continues to deliver explosive fantasy production in San Francisco despite playing through fractured ribs. David Montgomery's market has cooled slightly due to a week-to-week groin injury and per-touch efficiency dips, but he remains a legitimate early-down starter.
publicMarketAnalysis.aviVsMarket: Market values Evans highly for 2026 contenders but discounts his dynasty longevity given his age (33). Montgomery's short-term injury lowers his immediate trade leverage slightly.
relevantContext: Mike Evans posted 7 catches for 113 yards and a TD in Week 5 while playing through two fractured ribs.
David Montgomery exited Week 5 with a groin injury and is week-to-week, creating temporary health risk.
Northside Kings is in a confirmed Rebuild, making aging veterans like Evans primary trade candidates.

frontOfficeAnalysis.opposingGmMotivation: Northside Kings (Rebuilding) is motivated to convert 33-year-old Mike Evans into future assets and younger usable pieces.
frontOfficeAnalysis.packageFit: The submitted package provides a starting RB and a 2nd-round pick, which easily satisfies a rebuilding front office.
frontOfficeAnalysis.lineupReplacement: Northside Kings easily absorbs Evans' departure by elevating Jordan Addison, Khalil Shakir, or Xavier Worthy into the starting lineup.
frontOfficeAnalysis.competitiveWindowFit: Ideal fit for Northside Kings' rebuilding objective, though Corgi Loaf overpays from a win-now perspective.
frontOfficeAnalysis.positionalScarcity: In a 16-team league with 2 RB starting slots, reliable RBs are scarcer than WRs. Trading away Montgomery damages Corgi Loaf's RB depth resilience.

marketReality.explanation: Northside Kings would gladly accept this offer as constructed, as it overpays for 33-year-old Mike Evans by offering both an RB starter and a 2027 2nd-round draft pick.

verdict.rationale: While acquiring Mike Evans adds explosive scoring to Corgi Loaf's WR/FLEX rotation, sending both David Montgomery and a 2027 2nd-round pick is an unnecessary overpay to a rebuilding manager for a 33-year-old receiver. Removing the 2027 2nd-round pick balances the deal while preserving valuable draft capital.

recommendedOffer.whyUserShouldDoIt: Saves your 2027 2nd-round pick while still securing Mike Evans' elite weekly ceiling for your championship run.
recommendedOffer.whyOpponentMightAccept: Gives Northside Kings a proven starting RB in David Montgomery to stabilize their backfield or re-sell, fitting their rebuilding timeline better than holding a 33-year-old receiver.

alternateOffer.rationale: If Corgi Loaf prefers to keep David Montgomery for RB depth insurance, offering a 2027 2nd-round pick plus young WR Malachi Fields gives the rebuilder pure future upside without compromising Corgi Loaf's RB room.
